title: Lactate-related biomarkers in severe acute pancreatitis: insights from machine learning, molecular dynamics, and experimental validation.
summary: Specific biomarker/mechanistic result is linked to model-based prioritization and directly checked in patient samples/cell experiments; retain cohort association and in-vitro scope, and do not imply clinical utility. The bibliographic records retrieved do not state an author affiliation.
ai_technology: transcriptomic SAP vs non-SAP comparison; three ML methods nominate CCNA2 and H2BC5 among lactate-related genes; both higher in SAP clinical samples. Lactate addition and gene knockdown in vitro alter expression/inflammatory cytokines; Torin-1 reduced inflammation/oxidative stress in sodium-taurocholate cell model after docking/simulation. Evidence supports candidate biomarkers/mechanism in transcriptomic and cell models, not patient treatment efficacy.
